summaries.LBG22-KNOWN-PRIORITY-ORDER-BOUNDARY-01: Applicants know the fixed priority used at score-boundary ties. This clarifies the stated model, not a corrected admission policy or a new economic assumption.
summaries.LBG22-CONTINUUM-AE-BEST-RESPONSE-01: Equilibrium means that almost every applicant best responds against every feasible deviation; uniqueness is up to a null set.
summaries.LBG22-WEAK-STRICT-01: The main-text group comparisons are exact under clarified weak/strict interpretation. Strictness requires positive disadvantaged effort; classical derivative existence is qualified separately.
summaries.LBG22-HARD-BUDGET-01: The multitask model has nonnegative effort on both tasks summing to the stated budget. This is distinct from the unrestricted total effort in the multidimensional ranking model.

assumption_summaries.43c1d9f8274ce1870dee5d5d57abbeccd376af59: Proposition 3.1's two-level monotonicity clause uses local upper-tail skill and score-cost concavity. Pure-randomization optimality has no added shape assumption.
assumption_summaries.f2c5303f950a6e3f57cde94c07778165e8416f53: Proposition B.2 uses local affine measurable skill, a sufficient budget bound, production/cost curvature, and regularity conditions. The precise primitive package is stated in the source clarification note.
